name: Salivary Gland Carcinoma, Systemic Therapy for Recurrent or Metastatic Disease (biomarker-directed and cytotoxic options; doses require verification)
histology: salivary gland carcinoma, heterogeneous group (includes adenoid cystic carcinoma, salivary duct carcinoma, mucoepidermoid carcinoma, adenocarcinoma not otherwise specified). Adenoid cystic carcinoma has a tendency to recur along nerve tracks and can produce distant metastases 10 to 20 years after diagnosis (Harrison 22nd ed., lines 88330 to 88332).

biomarkers.note: Salivary gland carcinoma is biologically heterogeneous and systemic therapy is subtype- and biomarker-directed. AR-positive disease: DeVita 12th ed. (lines 66234 to 66240) grounds an androgen-deprivation regimen identity such as leuprolide (LHRH analogue) plus bicalutamide as first-line therapy (no doses printed). HER2-positive disease: DeVita 12th ed. (lines 66228 to 66232) grounds trastuzumab with or without pertuzumab plus a taxane, then ado-trastuzumab emtansine (T-DM1) or trastuzumab deruxtecan at progression (no doses printed). These are regimen identities only; the cited sources print no dose, basis, unit, route, or schedule, so AR and HER2 (and every dose field) remain VERIFY rather than being assigned a concrete dosing mapping here. The provided NCCN Head and Neck extract covers non-nasopharyngeal squamous cell sites and does not include salivary gland dosing (NCCN maintains separate salivary gland guidance not present in the extract).

lineOfTherapy: systemic therapy for recurrent or metastatic disease, given with palliative intent (Harrison 22nd ed., line 88333)

drugs.notes: Harrison 22nd ed. names, for metastatic salivary gland carcinoma, palliative chemotherapy with doxorubicin and/or a platinum agent, alone or in combination with a taxane, but states no doses or schedule. DeVita 12th ed. grounds the following regimen identities (no doses printed): cytotoxic CAP (cyclophosphamide, DOXOrubicin, and cisplatin) or vinorelbine with or without cisplatin (lines 66175 to 66178); HER2-positive disease trastuzumab with or without pertuzumab plus a taxane, then ado-trastuzumab emtansine (T-DM1) or trastuzumab deruxtecan at progression (lines 66228 to 66232); AR-positive disease androgen-deprivation therapy such as leuprolide (LHRH analogue) plus bicalutamide as first-line (lines 66234 to 66240). No agent dose, basis, unit, route, or schedule is established by the cited sources; all such fields are set to VERIFY. Do not administer until a concrete regimen and dose are verified against a cited source.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for systemic therapy of recurrent or metastatic salivary gland carcinoma (reference site #40, distinct from the squamous-cell head and neck sites #32 to 39 and #41). Salivary gland carcinoma is a heterogeneous group and systemic therapy is subtype- and biomarker-directed, so this protocol deliberately captures the systemic-therapy dose fields as VERIFY rather than inventing a regimen. The regimen IDENTITIES are source-grounded (no doses are printed in the cited sources): DeVita 12th ed. grounds cytotoxic CAP (cyclophosphamide, DOXOrubicin, and cisplatin) or vinorelbine with or without cisplatin (lines 66175 to 66178), HER2-positive trastuzumab with or without pertuzumab plus a taxane then ado-trastuzumab emtansine (T-DM1) or trastuzumab deruxtecan at progression (lines 66228 to 66232), and AR-positive androgen-deprivation therapy such as leuprolide (LHRH analogue) plus bicalutamide as first-line (lines 66234 to 66240). Harrison 22nd ed. (lines 88327 to 88338) grounds the qualitative approach for metastatic disease (palliative chemotherapy with doxorubicin and/or a platinum agent alone or with a taxane), with no doses stated. Because no dose, basis, unit, route, or schedule is printed for any of these regimens, biomarkers.AR, biomarkers.HER2, and the drug basis/dose/unit/route plus cycle length and cycle count all remain VERIFY. The provided NCCN Head and Neck extract covers Principles of Systemic Therapy for Non-Nasopharyngeal squamous cell sites and does not include salivary gland dosing (NCCN maintains separate salivary gland guidance not present in the extract). Setting recurrent/metastatic, palliative intent. Every systemic-therapy dose field is VERIFY; status remains DRAFT and cannot become ACTIVE until the VERIFY fields are resolved.
